key: TAKA: Easy there, killer...
en: TAKA: Easy there, killer...
ja: タカ: 落ち着いて、殺し屋さん……

key: TAKA: The least you could do is show some gratitude.
en: TAKA: The least you could do is show some gratitude.
ja: タカ: せめて感謝の気持ちくらい見せてくれてもいいんじゃない。

key: TITANIA: For what, your complete lack of a spine?
en: TITANIA: For what, your complete lack of a spine?
ja: ティタニア: 何に対して、あんたの完全な意気地なしっぷりに?

key: TAKA: I mean...
en: TAKA: I mean...
ja: タカ: いや、その……

key: If you wanna look at it that way.
en: If you wanna look at it that way.
ja: そういう見方をするならね。

key: But I figured you'd appreciate that I've taken the liberty of having her wounds treated.
en: But I figured you'd appreciate that I've taken the liberty of having her wounds treated.
ja: でも、彼女の傷を手当てさせてもらったことくらい、感謝してもらえると思ったんだけどな。

key: TITANIA: That's not the only thing you've taken.
en: TITANIA: That's not the only thing you've taken.
ja: ティタニア: あんたが奪ったのは、それだけじゃないでしょ。

key: TAKA: Ohhh, that's what this is about.
en: TAKA: Ohhh, that's what this is about.
ja: タカ: ああ、そういうことか。

key: TITANIA: Give me the Sapphire Bracelets.
en: TITANIA: Give me the Sapphire Bracelets.
ja: ティタニア: サファイアのブレスレットを返して。

key: TAKA: Sure.
en: TAKA: Sure.
ja: タカ: いいよ。

key: Catch.
en: Catch.
ja: ほら、キャッチして。

key: Titania received the Sapphire Bracelets!
en: Titania received the Sapphire Bracelets!
ja: ティタニアはサファイアのブレスレットを受け取った!

key: TITANIA: You're pathetic.
en: TITANIA: You're pathetic.
ja: ティタニア: 情けないわね。

key: TAKA: Maybe, but, hey.
en: TAKA: Maybe, but, hey.
ja: タカ: かもね、でもさ。

key: Someone's coming over to collect that.
en: Someone's coming over to collect that.
ja: それ、もうすぐ誰かが回収しに来るよ。

key: I kinda had to radio it in before.
en: I kinda had to radio it in before.
ja: さっき無線でそう伝えないといけなかったから。

key: Sooooo you might have to deal with that soon.
en: Sooooo you might have to deal with that soon.
ja: だから、まあ、そのうち対処しなきゃいけなくなるかもね。

key: TITANIA: I'm willing to accept that responsibility.
en: TITANIA: I'm willing to accept that responsibility.
ja: ティタニア: その責任、喜んで引き受けるわ。

key: TITANIA: Give my regards to the men who treated her.
en: TITANIA: Give my regards to the men who treated her.
ja: ティタニア: 彼女を手当てしてくれた人たちに、よろしく伝えといて。

key: TAKA: I would, but you kinda already killed them.
en: TAKA: I would, but you kinda already killed them.
ja: タカ: 伝えたいけど、あんたがもう殺しちゃっただろ。

key: TITANIA: ...Right.
en: TITANIA: ...Right.
ja: ティタニア: ……そうだったわね。

key: Well...
en: Well...
ja: まあ……

key: Tough.
en: Tough.
ja: 気の毒に。

key: TITANIA: So you're just going to let us walk out of here with Amy and the bracelets.
en: TITANIA: So you're just going to let us walk out of here with Amy and the bracelets.
ja: ティタニア: それで、あたしたちがエイミーとブレスレットを持ってここから出て行くのを、そのまま見逃すってわけ。

key: TAKA: Yup.
en: TAKA: Yup.
ja: タカ: うん。

key: Well, actually, I do have one favor to ask.
en: Well, actually, I do have one favor to ask.
ja: まあ、実は一つだけお願いがあるんだけどな。

key: I kinda need \PN to beat me in battle.
en: I kinda need \PN to beat me in battle.
ja: 僕、\PNにバトルで負けてもらう必要があってさ。

key: Gotta at least look like I tried.
en: Gotta at least look like I tried.
ja: 少なくとも、頑張ったふりくらいはしないと。

key: TITANIA: Just save yourself the embarrassment and resign already.
en: TITANIA: Just save yourself the embarrassment and resign already.
ja: ティタニア: いいから、恥をかく前にさっさと辞任すれば。

key: You're only making a fool of everyone involved.
en: You're only making a fool of everyone involved.
ja: あんた、関わってる全員をバカにしてるだけよ。

key: TAKA: Then I'm a fool.
en: TAKA: Then I'm a fool.
ja: タカ: なら、僕はバカでいいよ。

key: But I can't just walk out on my destiny.
en: But I can't just walk out on my destiny.
ja: でも、自分の運命から逃げ出すことなんてできないんだ。

key: TITANIA: Door's right here.
en: TITANIA: Door's right here.
ja: ティタニア: ドアはすぐそこよ。

key: No one's stopping you.
en: No one's stopping you.
ja: 誰も止めてないわ。

key: TAKA: My blood is.
en: TAKA: My blood is.
ja: タカ: 僕の血が止めてるんだ。

key: And my father--
en: And my father--
ja: それに、父さんが――

key: Do you have any idea what he would do?
en: Do you have any idea what he would do?
ja: 父さんが何をするか、分かる?

key: Do you have any idea how he would feel?
en: Do you have any idea how he would feel?
ja: 父さんがどう感じるか、分かるかな?

key: TITANIA: Probably slightly better than the countless people he's hurt.
en: TITANIA: Probably slightly better than the countless people he's hurt.
ja: ティタニア: あんたの父親が今まで傷つけてきた数えきれない人たちよりは、多分ちょっとマシな気分でしょうね。

key: TAKA: ...Look, just forget about it.
en: TAKA: ...Look, just forget about it.
ja: タカ: ……ねえ、もういいから忘れてよ。

key: Hurry up, beat me, and get out of here already.
en: Hurry up, beat me, and get out of here already.
ja: 早く、僕を倒してさっさとここを出て行ってくれ。

key: TITANIA: If you're not going to stop us, I'm not going to enable you to keep cowering from your choices.
en: TITANIA: If you're not going to stop us, I'm not going to enable you to keep cowering from your choices.
ja: ティタニア: あんたがあたしたちを止めないなら、あんたがその選択から逃げ続けるのを、あたしが助けてやる気はないわ。

key: If we defeat you, we just let you go on like this.
en: If we defeat you, we just let you go on like this.
ja: あんたを倒したところで、あたしたちはあんたをこのまま放っておくだけよ。

key: TAKA: Please...
en: TAKA: Please...
ja: タカ: お願い……

key: I've done every courtesy that I could for you down here.
en: I've done every courtesy that I could for you down here.
ja: 僕がここで君にできる礼儀は、もう全部尽くしたんだ。

key: Do me this one favor.
en: Do me this one favor.
ja: この一つだけ、お願いを聞いてくれ。

key: TITANIA: I'm done with your games.
en: TITANIA: I'm done with your games.
ja: ティタニア: あんたの茶番にはもう付き合ってられない。

key: Let's go, \PN.
en: Let's go, \PN.
ja: 行くわよ、\PN。

key: TAKA: \PN.
en: TAKA: \PN.
ja: タカ: \PN。

key: Please...
en: Please...
ja: お願い……

key: I'm begging you.
en: I'm begging you.
ja: 頼むよ。

key: Will you defeat me?
en: Will you defeat me?
ja: 僕を倒してくれる?

key: TAKA: Right. Let's hurry.
en: TAKA: Right. Let's hurry.
ja: タカ: そうだね。急ごう。

key: Thank you...
en: Thank you...
ja: ありがとう……

key: TAKA: Then, everything's gonna be just fine.
en: TAKA: Then, everything's gonna be just fine.
ja: タカ: それなら、全部うまくいくよ。

key: Let me heal your team.
en: Let me heal your team.
ja: 君のポケモンを回復させてあげる。

key: It's the least I can do.
en: It's the least I can do.
ja: せめてものおわびだよ。

key: TAKA: You should get outta here quickly.
en: TAKA: You should get outta here quickly.
ja: タカ: 早くここを出たほうがいい。

key: I get the feeling your friend's gonna need you.
en: I get the feeling your friend's gonna need you.
ja: 君の友達には、君が必要になる気がするから。

key: TAKA: ...I see...
en: TAKA: ...I see...
ja: タカ: ……そっか……

key: I guess I really am the odd one out when it comes to these sorts of things,
en: I guess I really am the odd one out when it comes to these sorts of things,
ja: こういうことに関しては、僕はやっぱり異端児みたいだね、

key: Trying to show mercy and all that...
en: Trying to show mercy and all that...
ja: 慈悲をかけようとしたりとか……

key: But hey.
en: But hey.
ja: でもまあ。

key: If skinning the black sheep makes you happy, whatever.
en: If skinning the black sheep makes you happy, whatever.
ja: はみ出し者を痛めつけて気が済むなら、それでいいよ。

key: ACE: Well, hello there, little darlings!
en: ACE: Well, hello there, little darlings!
ja: エース: おお、これはこれは、かわいい子たちよ!

key: ACE: Little prince, I understand you have something for us!
en: ACE: Little prince, I understand you have something for us!
ja: エース: 小さな王子よ、我々に渡すものがあると聞いているが!

key: TAKA: Uh... About that.
en: TAKA: Uh... About that.
ja: タカ: あ……それなんだけど。

key: ACE: Hmmmm?
en: ACE: Hmmmm?
ja: エース: ふむ?

key: TAKA: I had the Bracelets for a bit, but...
en: TAKA: I had the Bracelets for a bit, but...
ja: タカ: ブレスレットは少しの間持ってたんだけど……

key: ACE: Seeing as \PN is here, I can pretty much guess what happened!
en: ACE: Seeing as \PN is here, I can pretty much guess what happened!
ja: エース: \PNがここにいるのを見れば、何が起きたかはだいたい察しがつくというものだ!

key: I, for one, see no need to keep the audience waiting!
en: I, for one, see no need to keep the audience waiting!
ja: 私としては、観客を待たせておく必要はないと思うのだがね!

key: ACE: Let us see if we can't magic those Sapphire Bracelets away from \PN by the count of three!
en: ACE: Let us see if we can't magic those Sapphire Bracelets away from \PN by the count of three!
ja: エース: それでは、三つ数える間に\PNからサファイアのブレスレットを魔法で消し去れるか、見てみようではないか!

key: You don't have them, do you?
en: You don't have them, do you?
ja: スペードのエース: 持っていないのだろう?

key: ACE: Little prince, what's going on here?
en: ACE: Little prince, what's going on here?
ja: エース: 小さな王子よ、これは一体どういうことだ?

key: \PN doesn't have the Bracelets anyway.
en: \PN doesn't have the Bracelets anyway.
ja: \PNはそもそもブレスレットを持っていない。

key: I've done enough sleights of hand that I can tell that, plain as day.
en: I've done enough sleights of hand that I can tell that, plain as day.
ja: 手品には十分手慣れているのでね、そのくらいは一目瞭然だよ。

key: TAKA: They were, uh, taken.
en: TAKA: They were, uh, taken.
ja: タカ: それは、その、奪われたんだ。

key: By someone else.
en: By someone else.
ja: 別の誰かに。

key: That Steel Leader.
en: That Steel Leader.
ja: あのはがねタイプのリーダーに。

key: She held an Aegislash to my throat...
en: She held an Aegislash to my throat...
ja: ギルガルドを僕の喉元に突きつけられて……

key: ACE: Forgive me, little prince, but something's still not matching up here.
en: ACE: Forgive me, little prince, but something's still not matching up here.
ja: エース: 許してくれ、小さな王子よ、だがどうもつじつまが合わないのだ。

key: It seems to me that your team is entirely unscathed,
en: It seems to me that your team is entirely unscathed,
ja: 見たところ、君のチームはまったくの無傷のようだし、

key: And indeed, I look about, and I see no sign of a struggle.
en: And indeed, I look about, and I see no sign of a struggle.
ja: 実際、見回してみても、争った形跡が一つも見当たらない。

key: This place is exactly as sordid and disorderly as it is normally wont to be.
en: This place is exactly as sordid and disorderly as it is normally wont to be.
ja: この場所は、いつもと変わらず、みすぼらしく散らかったままだ。

key: Far be it for me to doubt the scion of the family, but I must wonder precisely what transpired here.
en: Far be it for me to doubt the scion of the family, but I must wonder precisely what transpired here.
ja: 一族の跡取りを疑うようなことはしたくないのだがね、しかし、ここで正確に何が起きたのか、気にならずにはいられない。

key: ACE: ...I see.
en: ACE: ...I see.
ja: エース: ……なるほど。

key: No matter.
en: No matter.
ja: どうでもいいことだ。

key: ACE: Deplorable.
en: ACE: Deplorable.
ja: エース: 嘆かわしいことだ。

key: Then I understand I've bungled the timing on this trick.
en: Then I understand I've bungled the timing on this trick.
ja: どうやら、この手品のタイミングをしくじってしまったようだね。

key: Surely by now, she's made whatever grand escape she wished to.
en: Surely by now, she's made whatever grand escape she wished to.
ja: 今頃はもう、彼女も望み通りの華麗な脱出を果たしていることだろう。

key: No matter!
en: No matter!
ja: なに、構わないさ!

key: ACE: Poof!
en: ACE: Poof!
ja: エース: ポン!

key: Thanks to the magic of digital communication, the mistake has been mollified!
en: Thanks to the magic of digital communication, the mistake has been mollified!
ja: デジタル通信の魔法のおかげで、この失敗もなだめられたというわけだ!

key: TAKA: ...Does a pager count as digital communication?
en: TAKA: ...Does a pager count as digital communication?
ja: タカ: ……ポケベルってデジタル通信に入るのかな?

key: ACE: Oh, come off it.
en: ACE: Oh, come off it.
ja: エース: おいおい、よしてくれ。

key: The service down here is as shoddy as it could be, so this was the most reliable way to signal off.
en: The service down here is as shoddy as it could be, so this was the most reliable way to signal off.
ja: ここら一帯の電波状況はこの上なくお粗末でね、これが一番確実な連絡手段だったのだよ。

key: The point is, the team outside was ready for a setback like this.
en: The point is, the team outside was ready for a setback like this.
ja: 要は、外にいるチームはこの手の失敗に備えていたということだ。

key: They'll be tying up the loose ends in a neat little bow any moment!
en: They'll be tying up the loose ends in a neat little bow any moment!
ja: 今にも、きれいなリボンをかけて後始末をつけてくれるだろうよ!

key: If you'd like to do something about it, best you run along, little hero~
en: If you'd like to do something about it, best you run along, little hero~
ja: それが気に入らないなら、さっさと追いかけたほうがいいのではないかな、小さな英雄くん~

key: ACE: And now that we don't have an audience,
en: ACE: And now that we don't have an audience,
ja: エース: さて、観客もいなくなったことだし、

key: Something is the matter with you, little prince.
en: Something is the matter with you, little prince.
ja: 小さな王子よ、君には何か気にかかることがあるようだ。

key: I need you to tell me what.
en: I need you to tell me what.
ja: それが何か、話してもらわなくてはね。

key: Something else is the matter with you, little prince.
en: Something else is the matter with you, little prince.
ja: 小さな王子よ、それとは別に、もう一つ気にかかることもあるようだ。

key: I'd like it if you would tell me what.
en: I'd like it if you would tell me what.
ja: それが何か、聞かせてもらいたいのだが。

key: TAKA: Ace, I--
en: TAKA: Ace, I--
ja: タカ: エース、僕――

key: I don't know what to do.
en: I don't know what to do.
ja: どうすればいいのか、分からないんだ。

key: ACE: Why don't you start by telling me exactly what it is that needs doing about?
en: ACE: Why don't you start by telling me exactly what it is that needs doing about?
ja: エース: では、何をどうにかしなければならないのか、正確なところから話してみてはどうかな?

key: TAKA: I-- I don't know...
en: TAKA: I-- I don't know...
ja: タカ: ぼ――僕にも分からないんだ……

key: If Father finds out--
en: If Father finds out--
ja: もし父さんに知られたら――

key: If she finds out...
en: If she finds out...
ja: もし彼女に知られたら……

key: I-- I shouldn't say anything.
en: I-- I shouldn't say anything.
ja: や――やっぱり、何も言わないほうがいい。

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: 忘れて。

key: ACE: ...Little prince, might I remind you that one of my many magical talents includes mind-reading?
en: ACE: ...Little prince, might I remind you that one of my many magical talents includes mind-reading?
ja: エース: ……小さな王子よ、私の数々の魔法の才能の一つに、読心術があることを忘れてはいないかね?

key: TAKA: Oh, come on.
en: TAKA: Oh, come on.
ja: タカ: ええ、よしてよ。

key: ACE: No, no, and I'll demonstrate again for you~
en: ACE: No, no, and I'll demonstrate again for you~
ja: エース: いや、いや、もう一度証明してみせようではないか~

key: Right now, you're thinking...
en: Right now, you're thinking...
ja: 今この瞬間、君はこう考えている……

key: That you want to tell me everything, but you're not sure if you can.
en: That you want to tell me everything, but you're not sure if you can.
ja: 私に全部話してしまいたいが、それができるかどうか自信がない、と。

key: Including how you gave the others the Sapphire Bracelets freely,
en: Including how you gave the others the Sapphire Bracelets freely,
ja: 他の者たちにサファイアのブレスレットをあっさり渡してしまったこと、

key: And asked \PN to fight you, but were refused,
en: And asked \PN to fight you, but were refused,
ja: \PNに戦いを挑んでほしいと頼んで、断られたこと、

key: And fought \PN to hide it,
en: And fought \PN to hide it,
ja: それを隠すために\PNと戦ったこと、

key: Because you don't agree with your father's actions,
en: Because you don't agree with your father's actions,
ja: 父上のやり方に賛成できないでいること、

key: But feel that you can't disappoint him,
en: But feel that you can't disappoint him,
ja: それでも父上を失望させるわけにはいかないと感じていること、

key: And worse--
en: And worse--
ja: そして、もっと悪いことに――

key: That someone is holding your back against the wall--
en: That someone is holding your back against the wall--
ja: 誰かが君を追い詰め、壁際に追いやっていること――

key: Yes, I can see it clearly in your head!
en: Yes, I can see it clearly in your head!
ja: ああ、君の頭の中がはっきりと見えるとも!

key: That is...
en: That is...
ja: つまり……

key: Lin, isn't it?
en: Lin, isn't it?
ja: リンだろう?

key: TAKA: Okay, you can't keep doing this...
en: TAKA: Okay, you can't keep doing this...
ja: タカ: もう、こういうのやめてよ……

key: I'm not a kid anymore, Ace.
en: I'm not a kid anymore, Ace.
ja: 僕はもう子供じゃないんだ、エース。

key: ACE: Ah, but you'll always be the little prince to me~
en: ACE: Ah, but you'll always be the little prince to me~
ja: エース: ああ、だが私にとって、君はいつまでも小さな王子なのだよ~

key: And you can't honestly tell me I'm wrong, can you?
en: And you can't honestly tell me I'm wrong, can you?
ja: それに、私が間違っているとは、正直言えないだろう?

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: They say I'm a liability.
en: They say I'm a liability.
ja: 僕はお荷物だって言われてる。

key: I guess I just proved them right.
en: I guess I just proved them right.
ja: それを自分で証明しちゃったみたいだ。

key: But Lin told me that if I failed one more time, she would make sure there wouldn't be a second.
en: But Lin told me that if I failed one more time, she would make sure there wouldn't be a second.
ja: でもリンには、もう一度失敗したら、次はないようにするって言われてるんだ。

key: ACE: And yet, surely your father will not abide by someone threatening his only heir.
en: ACE: And yet, surely your father will not abide by someone threatening his only heir.
ja: エース: それでも、たった一人の跡取りを脅す者を、君の父上が黙って許すはずがなかろう。

key: TAKA: Sometimes I think it would be easier for him if I disappeared...
en: TAKA: Sometimes I think it would be easier for him if I disappeared...
ja: タカ: 時々思うんだ、僕が消えたほうが父さんも楽なんじゃないかって……

key: ACE: To be plain, my dear, that's his problem, not yours.
en: ACE: To be plain, my dear, that's his problem, not yours.
ja: エース: はっきり言おう、それは彼の問題であって、君の問題ではないのだ。

key: No, you of all people cannot be shooed off the stage.
en: No, you of all people cannot be shooed off the stage.
ja: いや、よりにもよって君が、舞台から追い出されるなど許されはしない。

key: It is entirely anti-quintessential to the make-up of this family.
en: It is entirely anti-quintessential to the make-up of this family.
ja: それは、この一族というものの本質に、まったく反することだ。

key: I have thought for a spell already that Lin does not respect that.
en: I have thought for a spell already that Lin does not respect that.
ja: リンがそれを軽んじていることには、私も前々から気づいていたのだよ。

key: Have you seen the way Sirius acts around her now?
en: Have you seen the way Sirius acts around her now?
ja: 最近のシリウスの、彼女に対する態度を見たことがあるかね?

key: And what of all this "New World" nonsense?
en: And what of all this "New World" nonsense?
ja: それに、あの「新世界」とかいうたわごとは一体何なのだ?

key: Was our goal once not simply to safeguard the magic inherent to our own region?
en: Was our goal once not simply to safeguard the magic inherent to our own region?
ja: かつての我々の目的とは、この地方に宿る魔法を守ることだけだったはずではないか?

key: What good is that if we then toss out the script and write it anew?
en: What good is that if we then toss out the script and write it anew?
ja: それなのに、台本を放り出して新しく書き直すというのなら、一体何の意味があるのだ?

key: I believe trouble is afoot.
en: I believe trouble is afoot.
ja: 厄介事が起きていると、私は見ている。

key: Her foot, in particular.
en: Her foot, in particular.
ja: 特に、彼女の足元でな。

key: She has been making power plays ever since she replaced me with that literal clown.
en: She has been making power plays ever since she replaced me with that literal clown.
ja: あの本物の道化と私を入れ替えて以来、彼女は権力争いを重ねているのだよ。

key: Come to think of it, no--
en: Come to think of it, no--
ja: 考えてみれば、いや――

key: Even before that, she was pressuring Borealis.
en: Even before that, she was pressuring Borealis.
ja: それよりも前から、彼女はボレアリスを追い詰めていた。

key: I believe it's time we appraise your father of the situation and see that he takes decisive action on the matter.
en: I believe it's time we appraise your father of the situation and see that he takes decisive action on the matter.
ja: そろそろ、この状況を君の父上に知らせて、断固たる措置を取ってもらうべき時だと思うのだ。

key: TAKA: ...He won't listen to anything I say.
en: TAKA: ...He won't listen to anything I say.
ja: タカ: ……父さんは僕の言うことなんて聞いてくれないよ。

key: He'll just say I need to grow a spine or whatever.
en: He'll just say I need to grow a spine or whatever.
ja: どうせ、もっと骨のある人間になれとか言われるだけさ。

key: I get that a lot these days.
en: I get that a lot these days.
ja: 最近、よく言われるんだ。

key: ACE: Then allow me to be the one to open the matter.
en: ACE: Then allow me to be the one to open the matter.
ja: エース: では、この件を切り出す役目は、私が引き受けようではないか。

key: I'll contact him at once and make it clear that Lin needs to be expunged from the team.
en: I'll contact him at once and make it clear that Lin needs to be expunged from the team.
ja: ただちに彼に連絡を取り、リンをチームから排除すべきだとはっきり伝えるとしよう。

key: She has no love or understanding of family anyway.
en: She has no love or understanding of family anyway.
ja: どのみち、彼女には家族への愛情も理解も、まるでないのだからね。

key: She is only here for power, and I will neither stand nor sit for it.
en: She is only here for power, and I will neither stand nor sit for it.
ja: 彼女はただ権力のためだけにここにいる。私はそんなこと、立っても座っても容認するつもりはない。

key: Rest yourself, tired scion.
en: Rest yourself, tired scion.
ja: ゆっくり休むといい、疲れた跡取りよ。

key: This will all be resolved soon.
en: This will all be resolved soon.
ja: これはすぐに片がつくだろう。

key: TAKA: Ace--
en: TAKA: Ace--
ja: タカ: エース――

key: I wanted to say--
en: I wanted to say--
ja: 言いたかったんだけど――

key: Um... I really...
en: Um... I really...
ja: あの……僕、本当に……

key: ACE: Hmm?
en: ACE: Hmm?
ja: エース: ん?

key: TAKA: Can you really read minds?
en: TAKA: Can you really read minds?
ja: タカ: 本当に心が読めるの?

key: ACE: What do you think, little prince?
en: ACE: What do you think, little prince?
ja: エース: どう思うかね、小さな王子よ?

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
